senses.gloss: f.(b. h., prob. fr. דמם , cmp. foreg.; thick and moist) [earth], clay.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 14:8">Gen. R. s. 14</cite> the potter takes sand (<he>עפר</he>) which is male (masc. gender) and clay (<cite ref="A00422"><he>אדמה</he></cite>) which is female (fem. gender).—

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 8:5">Sabb. VIII, 5</cite> <he>א׳ כחותם וכ׳</he> as much clay as is required for a seal on bag-knots. [For the meaning of the phonetic equivalents of our w. in other Semit. tongues, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.]
